title: A starry night with friends
excerpt: Swirls, moonlight, and a silhouette that still makes me smile when I look at the canvas.
body:
I have always loved gentle forest spirits and still-summer skies. On @zradni_sarra I shared fan-feeling sketches — never official posters, just affection for that world.

This painting is that affection in acrylic: stars that swirl, a cheerful shape, moonlight that feels close. It belongs to the same journey as the old drawings, only thicker paint and a wooden stretcher.

The image here is the painting as it sits on the easel.
